title: Right Goal, Wrong Body: Re-grounding Frozen VLAs under Actuation Shift
abstract: arXiv:2611.20244v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are capable of producing desired robotic behaviors in ideal settings. However, they often fail when the robot's actuation changes at deployment. For example, remounting, mechanical wear, or command latency changes can lead to failed tasks and unsafe behaviors. To address the inevitable actuation shift, we propose ReGround, an inference-time method that keeps the VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion. ReGround learns the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, and then tracks the policy's intended motion while staying close to the policy's own plan. ReGround activates only upon detecting a shift, and needs no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining. translated_title: 目标正确，本体错误：执行机构偏移下冻结VLA模型的重新锚定
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够在理想环境下产生期望的机器人行为。然而，当部署时机器人的执行机构发生变化，它们往往会失败。例如，重新安装、机械磨损或指令延迟变化可能导致任务失败和不安全行为。为了应对不可避免的执行机构偏移，我们提出了ReGround，一种推理时方法，它保持VLA模型冻结并重新锚定其预期运动。ReGround通过任务无关的电机乱动学习已部署机器人的动力学，然后在跟踪策略预期运动的同时保持接近策略自身的规划。ReGround仅在检测到偏移时激活，无需奖励、演示或重新训练。我们通过两个VLA、八个LIBERO任务和五种偏移设置表明，ReGround能够恢复接近最优的成功率，例如在400毫秒延迟下将π0.5的成功率从0.16提升至0.90，同时比线性补偿方法更安全。
tldr: 提出ReGround推理时方法，通过任务无关的电机乱动学习部署机器人的动力学来重新锚定冻结VLA模型的预期运动，无需奖励、演示或重新训练即可应对执行机构偏移，显著恢复任务成功率（如400ms延迟下π0.5成功率从0.16提升至0.90）。
en_tdlr: ReGround is an inference-time method that re-grounds frozen VLAs under actuation shift by learning the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, requiring no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining, and restoring near-oracle success rates (e.g., raising π0.5's success from 0.16 to 0.90 under 400ms latency).
